description: Triage register for @trailofbits/vsix-audit findings on the roo-plus VSIX. Every entry is a finding that a maintainer has characterized as by-design (content coincidence, bundled OSS, data/prose/source-map/grammar/WASM bytes, or declared capability). When run on demand (it is NOT wired into any publish pipeline), scripts/vsix-audit.mjs fails closed on any finding NOT listed here, on any severity/count escalation above the recorded baseline, and on degraded coverage (YARA-X unavailable) in a publish context. See SECURITY.md 'Optional on-demand VSIX audit' + DEBT #23.

scan.note: Full-coverage baseline (YARA-X present) of the 3.87.3 artifact. Not re-scanned by any pipeline; regenerate this file when a maintainer runs a deliberate on-demand pass and triages new or changed findings.
